title: Typing Skills
description: For school leavers who want to type fast, accurately and comfortably, a skill needed in almost every office and online job. In four weeks you will learn touch typing from the home row up, measure your speed and accuracy with built-in practice tools, and prepare for data-entry and transcription work.
outcomes: Set up a healthy typing posture and workspace
Touch type all letter rows, numbers and common symbols without looking
Measure your words per minute (WPM) and accuracy correctly
Follow a daily practice routine that steadily improves speed
Use keyboard shortcuts that save time in everyday work
Apply typing skills to data-entry and transcription jobs and avoid job scams
